memories.content: Bao runs a well-reviewed banh mi food truck. He wants to secure a regular weekend parking spot on a brewery lot. He plans to approach three brewery managers in person this Saturday. He knows that two of the breweries already host rotating food trucks, and the third never has.

Bao Tran plans to visit three breweries in person on Saturday, 2026-08-08, to ask about parking his food truck on their lots. The breweries are open during the day and managers are typically present. Bao has no prior arrangement with any of them.
